title: Everyday Market from Woolworths: 25% Cashback on $200.01-$1000 Spend (Excludes Coupons) @ ShopBack
body:
Deal: Everyday Market from Woolworths: 25% Cashback on $200.01-$1000 Spend (Excludes Coupons) @ ShopBack

[Rick Sanchez] Did min spend change from $50 to $200?
Title doesn't match the description
[ATangk] $50 is minimum for any tracking, $200 is min for bonus cashback.
[Hiphopopotamus] That's on me, noticed the up to on the banner late. $200 is taken from the previous 25% deal post .
[happyangus] Are we going to see a 30% CB offer on Friday 👀👀
[Jojamc] Id say yes. But the question is whether its capped at $150 or not
[mediamascot] Switch 2 Mario kart bundle for effective price of $630 after cashback?
https://www.woolworths.com.au/shop/productdetails/1132831645…
[GreenGuava] Better just to get it directly from Target for $629 without needing to worry about cashback
https://www.ozbargain.com.au/node/984768
[nicholasv] HODL for Cashback once this price drops!!
[Queue2Queue] Thanks, hopefully this works with the 28 degree card
[Krykey] Any mention of cap? Also, when it says Any promo code usage is not eligible for Cashback (including BF30), does that mean if you use the code, the entire order is invalid for cashback, or the portion that is discounted i.e $30 is not valid?
[Saddy] I'd assume it makes the transaction ineligible. That's usually how it goes.
[BlazinPast] If theres no cashback limit and a 5 order limit, if I've got a few things to order, I'd rather split out to separate orders so that if one item is defective, it would only affect the cashback of that particular one.
But would the spending cap still be $1000 across all 5, or $1000 for each one?
[Royale with cheese] Says later today. I say you are what some might say…. premature
[Breannalee] iPad A16 Blue is $718 - with 25% it brings it to $539, stacked with the $20 bonus it’s then $519.
Whats anyone’s opinion, good buy or do we think another retailer will have a better price in the future?
